about.headline: Designing for Long-Term Context & Human Control
about.summary: I am an information science graduate student and full-stack prototyper focusing on inspectable AI workflows, local-first software, and calm interfaces. My work explores how software agents can collaborate with authors over months of iterative project updates while respecting manual craft.

resume.headline: Curriculum Vitae & Experience
resume.summary: M.S. in Information candidate (2027) with 3+ years of experience shipping design systems, developer workflows, and research prototypes across academic labs and product teams.

experience.detail: Leading studio critiques and researching mixed-initiative document maintenance workflows.
Designed version-aware review queues and diff visualizations for multi-author documentation.

projects.title: Orbit Dock
projects.summary: A workspace launcher and local context indexer that keeps research notes, terminal sessions, and design specs synchronized across project milestones.
projects.detailOverview: Orbit Dock solves context fragmentation for solo builders. Instead of scattering bookmarks and markdown notes across folders, Orbit Dock indexes project directories and surfaces active blockers alongside recent commits.
highlights: Reduced project context-switching latency by 38% in a 14-participant diary study
Zero-cloud local indexing engine with deterministic snapshot diffs
Keyboard-first command palette with instant file preview

projects.title: Fieldnotes Studio
projects.summary: An audio-to-structured-insight synthesis notebook for qualitative UX researchers conducting longitudinal field interviews.
projects.detailOverview: Fieldnotes Studio links timestamped interview transcripts directly to affinity clusters. Every synthesized theme preserves verifiable verbatim quotes so research teams never lose provenance.
highlights: Verifiable quote-to-theme provenance links across 40+ hours of interviews
Exportable markdown evidence briefs for product stakeholders

projects.title: Common Ground Transit Map
projects.summary: An accessible community transit and walkability explorer built with neighborhood associations to audit bus stop amenities.
projects.detailOverview: Common Ground combines GTFS transit feeds with crowd-audited sidewalk and shelter accessibility reports, helping municipal planners prioritize winter maintenance and seating upgrades.
highlights: Mapped 220+ bus stops with volunteer-verified accessibility checklists
WCAG AAA high-contrast mode and screen-reader route summaries
Adopted by two local neighborhood mobility coalitions
